messages.author: Thomas Cheatham
messages.body:
It is working for me - Utah has been having some iPV6 DNS resolution issues so we disabled it - some internet providers come in with that by default so try restarting your browser to reset that cache of iPV6... --tec3
________________________________________
From: James Kress <jimkress_58.kressworks.org>
Sent: Friday, January 21, 2022 4:13 PM
To: AMBER.ambermd.org
Subject: [AMBER] Archive page
Is there a new URL for the Amber archive page?  When I go to ambermd.org
mailing lists archive link (
https://archive.ambermd.org/
), all I get is a
blank page with "Nothing here" as the only entry.
Thanks for any help.
Jim Kress

messages.author: James Kress
messages.body:
Thanks.  Turns out it was a Firefox issue.  Chrome works just fine.
Sometimes I really hate Firefox ...
Jim
